files.name: main.py
files.code:
import re
from collections import Counter
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer

def tokenize(text):
    return re.findall(r"[a-z']+", text.lower())

tokens = tokenize("The cat sat on the mat. The end!")
print(tokens)
print(Counter(tokens).most_common(2))        # túi từ: đếm tần suất

docs = ["the cat sat on the mat",
        "the dog barked and the dog ran at the cat",
        "quantum computers use qubits"]
vec = TfidfVectorizer(stop_words="english")
M = vec.fit_transform(docs)                    # ma trận thưa: tài liệu x từ
print(M.shape, vec.get_feature_names_out()[:5])

prompt.vi: Viết tokenize(text) (chữ thường, chỉ giữ các từ gồm chữ cái và dấu nháy đơn bằng re.findall) rồi in 2 từ phổ biến nhất của "the cat sat on the mat the end" bằng Counter.most_common(2).
prompt.en: Write tokenize(text) (lowercase, keeping only words of letters and apostrophes via re.findall) then print the 2 most common words of "the cat sat on the mat the end" with Counter.most_common(2).

solution.name: main.py
solution.code:
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer

docs = ["the cat sat on the mat",
        "the dog barked and the dog ran at the cat",
        "quantum computers use qubits"]
vec = TfidfVectorizer(stop_words="english")
M = vec.fit_transform(docs)
top_word = vec.get_feature_names_out()[M[1].toarray().ravel().argmax()]
print(top_word)
